# Planview PPM Pro - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Project portfolio management focused on fast time-to-value for portfolio, project, resource and time management.

Also known as: PPM Pro, Innotas. Solution areas: Project Portfolio Management. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Portfolio management** - a core capability of Planview PPM Pro: Prioritise, select and balance investments/projects across the portfolio.
- **Project management** - a core capability of Planview PPM Pro: Plan and execute projects: schedules, tasks, milestones, dependencies.
- **Resource management** - a core capability of Planview PPM Pro: Plan, allocate and manage people and roles across work.
- **Time tracking** - a core capability of Planview PPM Pro: Capture time/actuals against work.
- **Demand management** - a supported capability of Planview PPM Pro: Capture, evaluate and route new work requests (intake).
- **Financial management** - a supported capability of Planview PPM Pro: Budgets, forecasts, actuals and cost/benefit tracking for work and portfolios.
- **Capacity planning** - a supported capability of Planview PPM Pro: Compare demand with capacity by role/skill over time.
- **Reporting & analytics** - a supported capability of Planview PPM Pro: Dashboards and analytics across portfolios and work.

## Implementation considerations

- Confirm fit for multi-business-unit enterprise governance and strategic planning needs; consider Planview Portfolios where those are must-haves.
